escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Accept a valid-looking readiness packet from another target because its files already exist.

literal_case.procedure: Bind the packet to repository, work item, pull request, base and head before reuse.
literal_case.observed: Current remediation rebuilds a packet bound to the current target and exact material candidate before publication.

prevention_change.evidence: Bind every delivery packet to a semantic target before any reuse decision.

detection_change.evidence: Terminal target-binding validation rejects foreign or unbound packets before audit handoff.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat persistence success as complete even when the immediate refresh fails and stale state remains visible.

literal_case.procedure: Persist a mutation, reject the immediate refresh, and inspect alert, success status and mutation call count.
literal_case.observed: Exact-head parameter regression coverage keeps refresh failure visible, suppresses success and avoids replay.

prevention_change.evidence: Separate propagating post-mutation refresh from ordinary loaders and branch on refresh outcome before success.

detection_change.evidence: Force mutation success plus refresh failure in regression controls and verify no contradictory success or replay.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep an older ready certificate after later material writes and treat its exact-head controls as current.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the previously certified material identity with every later non-result write before accepting readiness.
literal_case.observed: The stale historical handoff is not reused; the current material candidate is refrozen after its exact-head workflow succeeded.

prevention_change.evidence: Any material write after a handoff invalidates the freeze and exact-head descendants.

detection_change.evidence: Post-write recovery classification requires refreeze before a new result-only child can be published.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Publish a valid handoff, then allow a later material commit and return the earlier handoff as if it were still terminal.

literal_case.procedure: Re-read the remote head after the final write, compare it with the published handoff, and inspect the complete post-publication delta.
literal_case.observed: This remediation requires the final response to be blocked unless the remote head is the published direct result-only child of the frozen material candidate.

prevention_change.evidence: Latch the terminal handoff only after the last repository write and always perform a fresh remote identity reconciliation before returning.

detection_change.evidence: A terminal guard compares published_handoff_head_sha with a newly observed current_head_sha and classifies every later path; any material delta re-enters post-write-refreeze.
